AuthorizationUnavailable.description: Current authority or durable audit is unavailable; no protected operation succeeds. Retry only after resolving availability; do not automatically replay writes.

Conflict.description: Stale expected version or concurrent commit. F0008 design maps an ADR-0008 exclusion violation to code temporal_conflict (retryable; no rows written).

Forbidden.description: Reserved for webhook mapping failures; user denials are reported as 404

Unauthenticated.description: Credential verification failed; reason code recorded in the audit event only

Unprocessable.description: Event cannot be mapped to a review item or reviewer principal

ContractAssertionAdmissionResultV1.description: F0006 server-computed protected result. F0016 must durably persist outcomes before marking a run complete. This internal result is not an HTTP endpoint or general log payload. No field grants permission.

ContractAssertionRecordV2.description: F0006 design contract, Phase B approved by operator 2026-11-01. Untrusted source claim; structural schema validation does not establish admission, authorization or canonical eligibility.
ContractAssertionRecordV2.title: AssertionCandidateV2

ContractCanonicalCommitRequest.description: Proposal for one canonical fact commit (master blueprint section 109.2; F0001-S0005). F0008 design: exactly one of valid_from (legacy pilot slots) or temporal (identity-v1 slots) is present.

temporal.description: F0008 (ADR-0078, Accepted): required for identity-v1 slots (rejected as temporal_fields_required when absent); omitted for legacy pilot slots, which keep valid_from/valid_to semantics. When present, valid_from/valid_to above must be omitted and are derived from this block.

ContractCanonicalCommitRequest.title: CanonicalCommitRequest

ContractCanonicalCommitResponse.description: Result of a canonical fact commit: the semantic commit id and the fact versions it produced (F0001-S0005). F0008 (S0002 AC7, remediation run 2026-11-18-bce4909b): a fact-temporal/v1 commit adds `versions`, one entry per written version in `fact_version_ids` order, carrying its temporal block; a legacy pilot commit omits it.

temporal.description: Absent for a legacy remainder on an identity-v1 slot.

ContractCanonicalCommitResponse.title: CanonicalCommitResponse

ContractContentArtifactManifest.description: Manifest of one accepted parse-once content artifact bundle (master blueprint sections 80, 81, 108.1; F0001-S0003). F0004 compatibility clarification: source.pdf is the observed retained-PDF filename; no v2 metadata is synthesized for legacy artifacts.

ocr.description: F0005-S0001-AC2 (ADR-0073 amendment 2026-10-27): OCR observed during this conversion. Absent or null means not observed (historical producers); never inferred.

ContractContentArtifactManifest.title: ContentArtifactManifest

ContractContentArtifactManifestV2.description: F0004 proposed v2 parse bundle. Date metadata and interpretation outputs are external, append-only records. Cross-file hashes, identity, duplicate paths and native asset closure require service validation.

ocr.description: F0005-S0001-AC2 (ADR-0073 amendment 2026-10-27): OCR observed during this conversion. Absent or null means not observed (historical producers); never inferred.

ContractContentArtifactManifestV2.title: ContentArtifactManifestV2

ContractContentRecordsV2.description: One JSONL record. Relational uniqueness, bounds, native references and geometry consistency are service checks. Positions refer to exact block.text in Unicode code points; identity normalization never rewrites source text.
ContractContentRecordsV2.title: ContentRecordsV2

ContractDocumentDateRecord.description: Append-only candidates and explicit selections; no automatic precedence. HUMAN provenance needs a trusted verifier, not schema validity alone. In v0.1 every selection, including a clear, carries a verified human selection decision; a service principal may record candidates but cannot select. A null candidate explicitly clears the selected date; no selection means undated. YEAR/MONTH/DAY preserve supplied precision.

human_decision.description: Verified human selection decision (F0022 producer). actor_principal_id here is the deciding human; the record's top-level actor_principal_id is the calling principal. Schema validity is not authority: the trusted verifier binds decision, document version, candidate (or clear) and expected previous selection.

ContractDocumentDateRecord.title: DocumentDateRecord

absence_scope.description: Exact interpretation scope searched (ADR-0039 D2). Never implies global absence. The artifact must be readable by the caller and owned by the slot's tenant/KB.

profile_release_ref.description: Pinned ontology-release (or system-predicate registry) reference recorded at creation; never part of slot identity.

ContractFactAnswerV1.description: F0007 answer carrier (ADR-0039 D1-D5, ADR-0077 D5). Stored as the canonical_fact_version.value of an identity-v1 slot; legacy pilot slots keep their unwrapped values. Only PRESENT carries a value. There is no access-denied state: authorization is decided before any answer is produced. Server canonicalization (decimal form, identifier and name normalization) happens before storage.
ContractFactAnswerV1.title: FactAnswerV1

decimal_value.description: Input and canonical value have at most 64 total characters including sign/point. Server semantic validation rejects exponent forms whose canonical expansion exceeds that bound before allocating it; every emitted canonical form is a valid reload input.

identifier_value.description: ADR-0039 D5 scoped identifier. normalized_value is server-computed from the identifier-type normalization table; a supplied value that differs is rejected.

money_value.description: ADR-0039 D4. Amount is an exact decimal string; a JSON number is rejected (MONEY_FLOAT_REJECTED). Input and canonical amount are bounded to 64 total characters including sign/point; oversized canonical expansions reject DECIMAL_INVALID before allocation. Original currency only in F0007: any conversion marker is rejected (CONVERTED_MONEY_UNSUPPORTED) at the domain validator, so the schema does not admit one.

name_value.description: ADR-0066 name value. normalized is server-computed (NFC, casefold, whitespace collapse); evidence must name an admitted F0006 v2 assertion in the slot's tenant/KB.

qualifier_value.description: Qualifiers use the scalar typed values only (no name values). Explicit null is rejected with QUALIFIER_NULL_REJECTED; an omitted qualifier contributes nothing to identity.

ContractFactSlotKeyV1.description: F0007 internal slot-resolution request (ADR-0077). Not an HTTP route. Tenant comes from the authorized scope, never from this payload. Qualifier names are declared by the predicate contract; ordering of the input object is irrelevant to identity.

member.description: Required to address a member of a MULTI slot; forbidden otherwise.

object_entity_id.description: Required for RELATIONSHIP predicates, forbidden otherwise.

predicate_key.description: Opaque namespaced predicate key with its major contract version (ADR-0077 D2). Identity uses the key, not the release reference.

predicate_release_ref.description: Pinned ontology-release (or system-predicate registry) reference recorded at creation; never part of slot identity.

ContractFactSlotKeyV1.title: FactSlotKeyV1

ContractFactSlotResolutionResultV1.description: F0007 server-computed resolution outcome (ADR-0077). Internal service result, not an HTTP payload. A rejection writes no slot, qualifier or member row. Authorization denial is not an outcome here: the caller receives the facade's non-disclosing denial before any validation detail.

predicate_key.description: Opaque namespaced predicate key with its major contract version (ADR-0077 D2). Identity uses the key, not the release reference.

ContractFactSlotResolutionResultV1.title: FactSlotResolutionResultV1

attestation_zone.description: Zone used to place bounds derived from document dates (an attestation-floor start or an UNKNOWN end).

ending_evidence_refs.description: Assertions whose documents state that the fact ended (UNKNOWN end only). attested_to is the earliest selected date among their documents.

expected_attestation.description: Optional echo. If present it must equal the server-derived values, otherwise ATTESTATION_MISMATCH.

valid_from.description: Known start. Omit or null for an unknown start: the server floors it at attested_from or rejects START_UNATTESTED.

document_date.description: An F0004 document-date value at its own precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD).

iana_zone.description: IANA time-zone name, for example America/Chicago or the fixed-offset Etc/GMT+6. Existence is validated against the server's zone database, not by this schema.

start_basis.description: How the start was obtained. TEMPLATE_FIELD and HUMAN count as grade A (G1 decision 1). ATTESTATION_FLOOR is server-assigned when the start is unknown and is never accepted from a caller.

version_id.description: The version whose unknown end or floored start produced the result. No value is returned.

valid_to.description: BOUNDED: the stated end. UNKNOWN: the integrity bound placed at the end of the attested_to period. OPEN: null.

validity_unknown_from.description: UNKNOWN end only: valid-time reads at or after this instant and before valid_to return validity-unknown.

ContractFactTemporalV1.description: F0008 contract (ADR-0078, Accepted): the valid-time block of a canonical commit for identity-v1 slots, and the temporal block returned for a temporal-v1 version. Structural checks only; truncation in zone, attestation derivation from F0004 document-date selections, succession and state guards run in the commit service and database triggers.
ContractFactTemporalV1.title: FactTemporalV1

ContractFactVersionReadV1.description: F0011 documents the existing FactVersionOut wire shape (flat timestamps), including the F0008 additive metadata. It changes no runtime response. Legacy pilot values remain unwrapped; temporal is omitted for legacy versions.
ContractFactVersionReadV1.title: FactVersionReadV1

ContractInformationStateV1.description: F0011 publication alias for the shipped definition. This adds no field, normalization rule or domain acceptance. ADR-0079 design; implementation proof pending.
ContractInformationStateV1.title: InformationStateV1

ContractInterpretationOutputManifest.description: Run-owned outputs stay outside the parse bundle. V1 reflects the existing checkpoint marker; proposed v2 adds pipeline identity and exact date-basis selection. The selected output schema is independent of content artifact version.
ContractInterpretationOutputManifest.title: InterpretationOutputManifest

ContractInterpretationResult.description: Provider-neutral output of one semantic interpretation run over a persisted content artifact (master blueprint section 108.3; F0001-S0003).
ContractInterpretationResult.title: InterpretationResult

ContractInterpretationResultV2.description: F0006 additive result version. No live producer is activated; the existing importer continues to accept only legacy v1. ContractProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details with a stable machine `code` and a `traceId` extension member (camelCase to match the framework API contract validator; every other payload is snake_case). F0001-S0001.

ContractReviewDecision.description: Governed outcome of one human review submitted from the Nebula Review Panel; corrections append and never rewrite the original assertion (master blueprint sections 75 and 125, ADR-0037, ADR-0057, ADR-0058; F0001-S0004).

action.description: ACCEPT, CORRECT, and REJECT are adjudications. BLOCKED is not: it records that the evidence could not be anchored, produces no assertion, and leaves the review item open (ADR-0058).

event_sha256.description: Hash of the submitted decision event; the idempotency key for resubmission of a batch.

evidence.description: The locator the reviewer actually saw, at the precision it was shown, carried onto any assertion this decision creates.

selector.description: W3C Web Annotation selectors, plus nebula:TableCellSelector as a declared local extension; character offsets are Unicode code points.

reason_code.description: Required for CORRECT, REJECT, and BLOCKED. EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED is the only reason code valid with BLOCKED.

reviewer_principal_id.description: Resolved from the authenticated session, never from the request payload (ADR-0049, ADR-0057).

ContractReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision

ContractScopedIdentifierV1.description: F0011 publication alias for the shipped definition. This adds no field, normalization rule or domain acceptance. ADR-0079 design; implementation proof pending.

EvidenceLocator.description: Where an assertion is grounded in the immutable artifact. Selectors follow the W3C Web Annotation Data Model, with nebula:TableCellSelector as a declared local extension for spreadsheet cells; character offsets are Unicode code points (ADR-0058).

FactAnswerV1.description: Published source-owned F0007 state-plus-value carrier; no new route or runtime shape.

FactValidityUnknown.description: F0008 (ADR-0078, Accepted). Identity-v1 slots only. The coordinate lies inside an unknown-end window or before an attestation-floor start; no value is disclosed.

FactVersion.description: F0011 contract consolidation documents the shipped flat FactVersionOut timestamps; no runtime response change. Phase B design approved by operator 2026-11-20; runtime implementation pending.

info.description: Semantic API for Nebula Insurance Brain. This revision covers F0001: the health endpoint and the proof-scope reads, the native review decision endpoint, and the canonical commit endpoint. Every protected path verifies credentials before any storage read, hydrates resource attributes server-side, evaluates policy through the Casbin adapter, and audits the decision. Denials are reported as 404 so resource existence is never disclosed (master blueprint sections 66, 118.2). F0002 design: all protected operations use current typed scope and restriction checks with durable decision audit. Internal AuthX context is never a public request payload; role grants remain unchanged. F0002 runtime is approved in its archived feature evidence. F0004 proposes dual-version verified content reads and integrity/unavailable responses; those refinements received Phase B design approval on 2026-10-16; implementation proof remains required.
info.title: Nebula Insurance Brain API

post.description: Executes master blueprint section 109.2 in one transaction (F0001-S0005). F0006 approved design adds source eligibility checks before any canonical effect: attributable v2 evidence and review/correction lineage retain kind, mood and verified evidence-origin restrictions. Current source READ and fact-slot COMMIT decisions share one unit of work. No new grants or required request fields; legacy pilot compatibility remains as documented in ADR-0075. Phase B design approved by operator 2026-11-01; runtime not claimed. F0007 Phase B design (ADR-0077; approved by operator 2026-11-09; runtime not claimed): for identity-v1 slots the value must be a fact-answer/v1 envelope, validated and canonicalized before any effect; absence-scope artifacts and name-evidence sources join the same-UoW source READ checks. A PRESENT member answer must retain its immutable canonical member key. Decimal input and canonical output are bounded to 64 total characters; oversized exponent expansions are rejected before allocation. Legacy pilot slots are unchanged. F0008 (ADR-0078, Accepted): identity-v1 slots require the fact-temporal/v1 block (per-bound granularity and IANA zone, end state OPEN/BOUNDED/UNKNOWN, start basis); attestation bounds are derived from F0004 document-date selections on the evidence. Split remainders keep their predecessor's payload, evidence and timestamps. Only closing an open recorded interval may update a historical version (database-enforced). Grade-C or attestation-floor starts and non-PRESENT states cannot close a PRESENT value. Legacy pilot slots keep the pilot request shape. F0008 remediation (S0002 AC7): a fact-temporal/v1 commit response adds `versions` with each written version's temporal block; a legacy pilot commit response is unchanged.

403.description: Reserved by the shared error catalog. These resource operations return 404 for authorization denial to conceal existence.

422.description: Authorized request references an ineligible or inconsistent assertion source; code ASSERTION_INELIGIBLE. No canonical mutation and no protected source excerpt. F0007 design (identity-v1 slots only) adds the lowercase answer-rejection codes listed in ADR-0077 D5 (for example state_value_mismatch, absence_scope_required, money_float_rejected, name_evidence_required, member_value_mismatch, decimal_invalid) with no detail text. F0008 (ADR-0078, Accepted) adds temporal_fields_required, granularity_invalid, time_zone_invalid, bound_not_truncated, end_state_invalid, start_unattested, attestation_mismatch, start_basis_invalid, succession_start_unanchored and state_supersession_refused.

post.description: Submitted by the Nebula Review Panel on the authenticated reviewer's session; the reviewer is the session principal and is never read from the payload (ADR-0057). The batch is applied in one transaction with one audit event per decision. Resubmission of an already-decided batch is a no-op; a decision against a superseded assertion version is recorded as stale and not applied; a field whose evidence could not be anchored is recorded as BLOCKED with reason code EVIDENCE_UNRESOLVED and produces no assertion (ADR-0058, F0001-S0004). Canonical commit is a separate authorization and never happens here. F0006 approved design retains v2 kind, mood, interpretation basis and source restrictions on additive corrections; the legacy request cannot strip them or perform unsupported semantic edits (422). No new screen or request member is introduced.
